Quick Start

Memory for your voice AI, in a few lines.

PYTHON
# 1. Install VoiceMem corepip install -e .from voicemem import VoiceMemvm = VoiceMem()vm.Ingest("Had ramen with Alex near the office at noon.", speaker="Speaker 0")result = vm.Search("what did I eat for lunch", slots=["food"])for hit in result.hits:    print(hit)
# 1. Install audio / environment / speaker featurespip install -e ".[audio,environment,omni,voiceprint]"bash scripts/download_models.sh service/models# 2. Start the streaming voice service (adjust entrypoint to your repo)export OPENAI_API_KEY="your-api-key"python service/main.py# Per utterance → end, ASR, entities, schema, emotion, speaker, embedding# Browser/client connects to the service WebSocket endpoint.
# 1. Use the maintained browser voice democd openai_voice_demoexport OPENAI_API_KEY="your-api-key"# 2. Start the app (adjust filename to your actual demo entrypoint)python app.py# 3. Open the local UIhttp://localhost:3000# Talk directly with the agent while VoiceMem handles memory.

Introduction

Two brains. One voice. Nothing to wait for.

流式 dual-brain 架构

左脑以 schema 和实体组织事实记忆，右脑以独立与跨实体节点建模人格与情绪。整条链路全流式——用户还在说话时就已完成切分、转写、抽取并入图，查询时先路由后排序，只取 Top-K 拼进上下文。

数据集和语音系列模型 built with OPD

ChatMem-400K 由记忆世界构建、SLM 验证的在线同策略蒸馏与人工精修三段流水线产出，并同时生成 ChatMem-Bench 评测集。Qwen2.5-Omni、Qwen3-Omni 与 Step-Audio2-Mini 经 OPD 蒸馏后学会主动调用记忆，且不损失原有语音能力。

DatasetVoiceMem/ChatMem-400K ↗ ModelVoiceMem/Qwen2.5-Omni-Mem ↗
